description: A grid of sixteen rows against a long run of steps, passing each input through to the matching output while that row's cell is turned on at the step now playing

params.text: Sets how many steps play before the sequence starts over
Sets the direction the sequence travels through its steps
Sends the sequence back to its first step
Turns every cell in the grid off
Chooses the pattern a randomise fills the grid with
Fills the grid with random cells
Sets how many cells a randomise turns on
Moves the step the sequence starts from

inputs.text: The signal that row passes to its output
Each trigger here advances the sequence by one step
A trigger here sends the sequence back to its first step
A trigger here turns every cell in the grid off
A trigger here fills the grid with random cells
Added to the R AMT knob, 0V to 10V covering its whole travel
Added to the LEN knob, 0V to 10V covering the length of the grid
Added to the play mode knob, 0V to 10V covering every direction
Added to the START knob, 0V to 10V covering the length of the grid

outputs.text: Carries that row's input while the row's cell is on at the step now playing, and 0V while it is off
A trigger at the end of each pass through the sequence
The step now playing, 0V to 10V across the length of the sequence
How many rows are turned on at the step now playing, 0V to 10V

notes: click a cell in the grid to turn it on or off, and drag across the grid to paint a run of them
holding shift and clicking the grid moves the playhead to that step instead of changing a cell
a row whose input is unpatched sends 0V whether its cell is on or off, so nothing passes until that row's input is patched or the menu is set to send 10V instead
menu: Absolute Position — measures the POS output across the whole grid rather than across the stretch between START and LEN
Default to 10V out when no input — sends 10V from a row whose input is unpatched while its cell is on, instead of 0V
